commands.label: Forest
commands.desc: Premium forest with layered natural depth.
commands.instruction: Integrate the exact product into a premium forest using trees, moss, roots, foliage, mist and shafts of light. Keep the scene brand-relevant, not generic green scenery.

commands.label: Jungle / Tropical
commands.desc: Dense tropical world with humidity and layered vegetation.
commands.instruction: Use lush vegetation, large leaves, humid atmosphere, filtered light and water droplets while keeping product visibility strong.

commands.label: Modern City
commands.desc: Contemporary urban architecture and street-scale energy.
commands.instruction: Integrate the exact product into a believable modern city using architecture, plazas, traffic, sidewalks or rooftops. Do not default to Times Square.

commands.label: Street / Urban
commands.desc: Street-level campaign with authentic urban detail.
commands.instruction: Use sidewalks, storefronts, crosswalks, alleys and street furniture in a polished, brand-fit way rather than generic graffiti.

commands.label: Country / Culture
commands.desc: Country or region-specific environment when explicitly supplied.
commands.instruction: Use the country/region named in the current request and build accurate high-level cultural/architectural cues without stereotypes. If none is supplied, use a neutral setting.

commands.label: Rural / Village
commands.desc: Countryside or village world with grounded detail.
commands.instruction: Use fields, village roads, farms, fences, carts, trees or local architecture while keeping the exact product premium and readable.

commands.label: Mountain
commands.desc: Epic high-altitude landscape with dramatic depth.
commands.instruction: Use believable mountains, cliffs, valleys, trails, rock and atmospheric haze. Integrate the product through an idea, not just placement.

commands.label: Desert
commands.desc: Cinematic dunes, rock and heat atmosphere.
commands.instruction: Use wind-shaped sand, dunes, desert rock, long shadows or oasis cues when relevant. Avoid unnecessary post-apocalyptic styling.

commands.label: Snow / Ice
commands.desc: Winter environment with realistic frost and cold light.
commands.instruction: Use believable snow accumulation, ice, frost and winter atmosphere while keeping product readable. Never imply temperature resistance.

commands.label: Beach / Coast
commands.desc: Bright coast, shoreline or boardwalk environment.
commands.instruction: Use sand, shoreline, cliffs, boardwalk or coastal architecture with believable sun, wind and reflections. Avoid stock-vacation styling.

commands.label: Underwater
commands.desc: Submerged environment with convincing water optics.
commands.instruction: Use realistic caustics, refraction, bubbles, suspended particles and depth falloff while preserving label readability. Never imply waterproofing.

commands.label: Space / Moon
commands.desc: Premium cosmic world with restrained sci-fi detail.
commands.instruction: Use lunar terrain, planetary scale, stars or orbital architecture only when useful. Avoid generic neon sci-fi clutter.

commands.label: Industrial / Factory
commands.desc: Engineered machinery and infrastructure world.
commands.instruction: Use machinery, pipes, production lines and engineered structures in a premium, purposeful way rather than dirty by default.

commands.label: Warehouse / Logistics
commands.desc: Large-scale warehouse or loading environment.
commands.instruction: Use racks, loading bays, conveyors, pallets or forklifts as spatial context. Do not imply logistics capabilities or partnerships.

commands.label: Luxury Interior
commands.desc: High-end spatial design with refined materials.
commands.instruction: Use refined architecture, stone, wood, glass, metal and controlled lighting as brand-appropriate. Do not default to black-and-gold.

commands.label: Gym / Fitness
commands.desc: Premium training environment with athletic energy.
commands.instruction: Use believable gym architecture and equipment while keeping the product central. Do not invent fitness/performance claims.

commands.label: Stadium / Sports
commands.desc: Large sports venue with dramatic scale.
commands.instruction: Use field/court, stands, tunnel or scoreboard architecture as environmental scale. Never imply official sponsorship unless supplied.

commands.label: Café / Restaurant
commands.desc: Dining or beverage environment designed around the category.
commands.instruction: Use counters, tables, kitchens, serving spaces, dishes or beverage-service architecture that fit the current product. Do not invent menu items.

commands.label: Retail / Store
commands.desc: Modern store or experiential retail environment.
commands.instruction: Use shelves, counters, windows, merchandising or checkout architecture as a designed world rather than a plain ecommerce shelf.

commands.label: Festival / Event
commands.desc: Event, fair or expo environment with large-scale energy.
commands.instruction: Use stages, booths, installations, crowd space or fairground structures appropriate to the current brief. Do not invent dates or sponsors.
